datasets.name: Edge-IIoTset
datasets.description: IoT/IIoT cyber-security dataset from a seven-layer testbed (more than 10 IoT device types), with fourteen attacks in five threat families. It is distributed with raw per-scenario CSV/PCAP files and two pre-selected tables for ML and DL.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (as listed on the first-party Kaggle upload)

citations.text: M. A. Ferrag, O. Friha, D. Hamouda, L. Maglaras, H. Janicke. Edge-IIoTset: A New Comprehensive Realistic Cyber Security Dataset of IoT and IIoT Applications for Centralized and Federated Learning. IEEE Access 10 (2022): 40281-40306.

datasets.name: TON_IoT
datasets.description: Heterogeneous IoT/IIoT telemetry, operating-system and network datasets collected on a testbed at UNSW Canberra. The publisher distributes raw, processed and Train_Test subsets. This project's candidate table is the Train_Test network subset; which subset the reference study used must be confirmed against its text (M2).

license.name: TON_IoT terms of use (publisher-specific, no standard license)

datasets.name: WUSTL-IIOT-2021
datasets.publisher: Washington University in St. Louis (Zolanvari, Teixeira, Gupta, Khan, Jain)
datasets.description: Network flow records (Argus features) from an IIoT testbed emulating industrial control systems, with command-injection, reconnaissance, DoS and backdoor traffic. The publisher reports 1,194,464 observations (87,016 attack, 1,107,448 normal) and 41 features after removal of six leaky columns.
